finding.detail: Cloudflare namespace multi-instance search requires ai_search_options.instance_ids. The adapter sent instance_ids under ai_search_options.retrieval, so the provider request did not follow the documented instance routing contract.

changes: Move instance_ids to the ai_search_options sibling of retrieval.
Assert expected top-level placement and reject nested instance_ids in adapter tests.
